contract.invalid_measurements: Malformed, nonfinite or noncausal observations terminally refuse and raise without issuing a command. No measured-position stop is claimed from invalid measurements.

contract.rate_scope: The extra correction slews at at most 0.002 rad per 20 ms per joint. Original native 1 ms target slew, servos, gains and force caps remain unchanged.

contract.sampling: Control checks occur at 20 ms boundaries. Independent saved 1 ms native evidence must judge a continuous 5 s hold; missed between-boundary failures remain findings.

acquisition_contract.evidence_admission: Current bilateral force >0.01 N, no table support, object rise >=6 mm and TCP-local offset drift <=3 mm continuously across sampled boundaries for elapsed >=100 ms.
acquisition_contract.hold: Latch measured six arm joints and the last issued jaw target at admission/terminal invalidity. No full lift/transfer, no squeeze escalation, no post-admission retry.
acquisition_contract.invalidation: At each subsequent 20 ms observation and final observation, invalidate immediately on lost contact/force, support, insufficient rise, >3 mm local drift or unexpected contact. Never requalify after terminal invalidity.
acquisition_contract.prefix: Original GuardedPiperTaskPolicy approach/close and at most one supported open/recenter/retry; already uses authored native state, not a fully blind baseline.
acquisition_contract.sampling_limit: Independent 1 ms evidence may contradict sampled admission; that remains a finding. No sensor or material inference is implemented.
acquisition_contract.stop_scope: Holding native position targets is not physical arrest or calibrated force limiting; inertia and existing target rate limits can continue motion.
acquisition_contract.timer_admission: Same 10 mm/20 mm/s probe target law, admitted at elapsed >=600 ms from that probe start; no evidence predicate or slip alarm before admission. Unexpected contacts and bounded timeouts still stop.

contract.acquisition: Unchanged ProbeStopPolicy evidence acquisition, including its bounded supported retry. All variants share the same prefix through the first admission observation.
contract.cartesian: Latch measured TCP position/orientation and preceding issued targets. Fixed joint bias equals issued target minus pose_action at the admission pose. First command repeats the exact issued target; later pose_action updates receive that fixed bias.
contract.final_observation: Repeat force, original eligibility and Cartesian pose-error checks. Do not solve or issue a hypothetical next control at the terminal observation.
contract.invalid_measurements: Malformed, nonfinite or noncausal observations terminally refuse and raise without issuing a command. No measured-position stop is claimed from invalid measurements.
